testcase.name: newest unsupported release does not hide an older compatible update()
unsupported Android is distinguished from no update()
package identity and matching manifest version are required()
one universal asset is offered to both ARM systems using the existing manifest contract()
device ABI order selects a compatible published APK()
old versions and non increasing build codes never trigger downgrade()
beta channel is opt in and numeric beta ten is newer than beta two()
default channel ignores drafts and prereleases even when tag is mislabeled()
stable of the current beta can be offered when its build code is newer()
real manifest shape ignores extra packaging fields and nullable release notes()
unsafe APK assets and invalid checksums cannot be offered()
all pages are inspected instead of trusting GitHub listing order()
network failures and cancellation are not presented as no update()
